notes.title: Update : Music Around the Beam
notes.notes:
Update:

1. After some attempts, the developer finally simulated Erhu playingːlunar2019crylaughingpigː. Now you can right-click on the chair, or right-click on the Erhu to play it. The scale of Erhu is set according to the traditional Chinese scale (C D E G A, no F and B). Even if you have no experience playing musical instruments, it will not be too unpleasant.

Notice:

After a series of updates, the developer suddenly discovered that this game should be renamed to "Stall Simulator"! Calligraphy stalls, Chess stalls, and Erhu stalls are all popular street stall projects on the streets of the small county town in Chinaːlunar2019crylaughingpigː. By now, the summer study scene has been completed! Next, because there are new projects to be developed, the developer will update and make the winter scene at the end of the year. Hope you can understand!

notes.title: Update：River & Border
notes.notes:
Update:
1. Added a Chinese Chess set on the couch. To play chess, it‘s best to sit on the couch first, then press middle mouse button or F button controls the camera facing the chessboard, right-click the chessboard, you can play the chess with two modes:

[b] Free mode :[/ b] You can move the pieces of Black or Red at will, which can better help players who have never played Chinese Chess to understand the rules of moving pieces. And after exiting the endgame mode, you can enter the free mode to study the various moves of the endgame.

[b] Endgame mode :[/ b] There are 10 endgame records. Although some endgames are very difficult, don't worry. If you are not interested in studying endgames or do not know the rules, right click the points on the board, you can pass the same!

2. Added the F key as a secondary control for camera rotation. Press the F key and move the mouse to rotate the camera.
